successors.name: Emirate of Afghanistan
successors.text: Shughnan on both banks of the Panj, with its vassal Roshan to the north (modern Shighnan, Shughnon and Rushon districts)

ledger.x: 1829: the mirs of Shighnan, with their vassal Roshan, pay tribute to Murad Beg of Kunduz.
September 1883: Abdur Rahman Khan annexes Shughnan, ending mir rule (subjugated in 1874 but the mirs kept ruling).

certainty.note: No frontier or capital on the page; modern districts used.
